scope: Recomputed archived rollout records and inspected training/evaluation sources; no new simulator rollouts or retraining.
hardware: H38 currently reports NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 D; FPP launch records GPU 5.

dataset.split_count_evidence: Matching MLflow params in both training databases; rollout test IDs verified.
dataset.historical_split_recipe: Reserve the final 20 raw IDs per task for test; choose up to 10 validation IDs from remaining available RGB IDs with NumPy default_rng(42 + task).
dataset.limitation: Recovered through H36; recorded split membership and initial-state hashes verified. This is not a byte-level re-audit of all raw states or a check for broader trajectory similarity.
dataset.text_encoder: Frozen CLIPTextModelWithProjection clip-vit-base-patch32; tokenizer padding enabled, no truncation; text_embeds [10,512].

schedule.initial: 500-step linear warmup, then cosine multiplier with floor 0.1 over the 30K schedule.
schedule.restore: model, AdamW state and torch/CUDA/NumPy/Python RNG; dataloader worker/prefetch state is not bit-exact

fpp.selection: 20K was selected after inspection of multiple checkpoints on this test suite; results are exploratory, not an untouched final test.

dp.observation_spacing: Adjacent 20-Hz control frames, not duplicated current frames.
dp.visual_backbone: Trainable ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 with GroupNorm, no crop/augmentation.
dp.scheduler: DDPM squaredcos_cap_v2; epsilon prediction; clip_sample=true; fixed_small variance
dp.schedule: 500-step linear warmup; cosine multiplier with floor 0.1 through 30K.

success_rule: official_final_done AND completed_subgoals == total_subgoals AND NOT overshot; run full horizon, no early exit at intermediate done.
horizon: max(task minimum [200,290,320,370,450,655,480,675,390,390], stripped raw demonstration length + 20). Paired identically; not supplied as policy conditioning.
reset: New env per rollout; reset, XML rebuild and simulator reset, restore init state, clear subgoal/overshot state, 20 open/no-motion settling steps.

accepted_failures.reason: 30.58 mm offset exceeds unchanged 30 mm On threshold; overshoot
Final transport fails in open-loop physics; recorded-state replay succeeds

replay_exceptions.verification: Recovered replay-audit file SHA256 matches original configs; 28/30 outcomes checked without rerunning.

source_verification.result: All nine archived training source hashes and all nine current evaluation source hashes match their launch records.
source_verification.vendor_revision_caveat: Vendor directories are snapshots inside CoreLab, not independent Git checkouts; parent CoreLab HEAD is not the environment revision.

release_differences.reference: Historical EOE + temporal RoPE and fixed 2D spatial sinusoidal features; manifest-pinned splits, symmetric min/max normalization, scheduled LR.
release_differences.package: GitHub package defaults to RoPE-only and now omits EOE; --append-eoe retains an explicit control. Its preparation defaults to final-20 validation, [0,1] normalization, stride10; constant LR/default AdamW betas.
release_differences.limitation: The current package is not an exact reproduction of these evaluated checkpoints; no post-EOE-removal SR has been measured.
